name: Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550
memory_bandwidth_basis: Intel ARK spec table: 128 GB HBM2e at 3.276 TB/s. 4096-bit bus implied by HBM2e stack configuration but not explicitly stated as a single number on ARK.
notes: Ponte Vecchio (PVC) is Intel's flagship data center GPU, the predecessor to the Battlemage-based Arc Pro B-series for the data center market. 128 GB HBM2e at 3.276 TB/s is the highest-bandwidth Intel GPU. 600 W TDP. Supports oneAPI/SYCL/oneDNN. Used in Aurora supercomputer. The Max 1100 is a cut-down variant with 72 GB HBM2e. Both are verified llama.cpp SYCL backend devices per the SYCL docs. The Max 1550 is the full-fat PVC with 48 GB or 128 GB HBM2e variants. Intel's data center GPU line is separate from the Arc Pro workstation line (B60/B70) and the consumer Arc line (B580). The Max Series is the only Intel GPU line with HBM; all Arc and Arc Pro parts use GDDR6.
